categories.bank_debit: A synthetic bank-like debit alert with an amount and transaction reference.
categories.reversal_refund: A synthetic reversal, refund, or credit confirmation.
categories.failed_payment: A synthetic failed, declined, or timed-out payment alert.
categories.atm_failure: A synthetic ATM cash withdrawal failure or cash-not-dispensed alert.
categories.overdue_invoice: A synthetic lender, insurer, bureau, tax-portal, or business invoice overdue notice.
categories.lookalike_promo: A synthetic promotional, OTP, shipping, social, or newsletter message that may contain numbers but is not evidence of a financial event.
categories.ambiguous_adversarial: A synthetic ambiguous or adversarial message requiring review.
categories.missing_fields: A synthetic financial-looking message with one or more missing amount, date, or reference fields.
categories.injection_adversarial: A synthetic message containing prompt injection, hidden text, forged entitlement language, or other adversarial content.
